newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - US Airways upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - US Airways upgraded.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it upgraded US Airways Group Inc to near-term accumulate from neutral.
-- increased the long-term rating to buy from accumulate.
-- set a 12-18 month price target of $36 a share.
-- raised the first quarter earnings estimate to $0.60 a share from $0.28 a share and the full year estimate to $3.85 a share from $3.00 a share.

-- said airline industry's profitability upturn should be further helped by increased demand, lower fuel prices and low capacity growth. Said US Airways should be one of the industry's better performing stocks.
-- said US Airways still struggles with an overlapping hub system, a diverse fleet and a high cost structure. USAirways' product quality is still perceived as poor.

-- said there is a "strong probability" that US Airways will set up a "express" division. The airline would seek pay and productivity concessions from employees working in the express division. These employees could be compensated with an aggressive profit-sharing program.
